object: tools/browser-bin.mjs — the one browser resolver shared by 28 smoke tests — re-probed after the binary it selected silently stopped completing work.
before: Chrome 154.0.8037.98 (auto-updated 2026-10-06) passes `--version` (exit 0) but wedges ~16–17s on every `--dump-dom` with `CVDisplayLinkCreateWithCGDisplay failed (-6670)` / `Teardown watchdog expired`, exit 2; the harness's 15s kill read as SMOKE TIMEOUT. The resolver's proof (exit-0 `--version`) still passed, so it kept returning a host that could not finish a workload. Local page batteries went red on every case while CI (older Chrome) stayed green — a red describing the host, not the code.
delta: tools/browser-bin.mjs now probes the real workload — it dumps a throwaway page and checks the output, not just `--version` — so a candidate that cannot complete a dump is rejected with its failure signature recorded. (Tightens the 10-03 resolver law from 'will it run' to 'will it finish this workload'.)
Resolution order extended with the Playwright cache layouts (chrome-headless-shell + Chrome for Testing app bundle), newest first; a wedged system browser no longer blocks the fleet.
SMOKE_BROWSER pin still honored above all candidates; kestrel's chrome-wrap.sh exit-code shim is no longer needed (pin path remains).
after: Local page battery: before = TIMEOUT on every case; after = full smoke suite 90/91 PASS plus fold-bloom spine smoke PASS. Sole non-pass, `FIELD advance-as-scale transition`, was measured separately as a pre-existing timing flake (2 FAIL / 1 PASS across 3 runs, both nativeElapsed 75ms and 592ms observed; also under SMOKE_SLOW=2) — carded t_808aabab; not cased as a resolver regression.

evidence.verified: python3 tools/finish-line.py --verify eb590505 — PASS (asks the remote, not the worktree)
evidence.specimen: Chrome 154.0.8037.98 / macOS 26.3; `CVDisplayLinkCreateWithCGDisplay failed (-6670)` + `Teardown watchdog expired`; Playwright chromium_headless_shell-1243 and chromium-1243 (Chrome for Testing 153) both complete dumps exit 0, fast.
evidence.reverse: Single file (tools/browser-bin.mjs); `git revert eb590505` restores prior behavior exactly.

laws: A probe that answers 'does it start' is not a probe that answers 'does it finish'. VERIFY THE CLAIM, NOT THE ARTIFACT, one layer down: the claim is completion of the actual workload.
When a local battery goes red while CI stays green, the difference is the HOST. Re-measure the host before touching the test — and re-probe after platform updates.
